reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration plugin that connects to the WeChat Coding Plan API and adapts streaming reasoning and tool-call responses for DSH.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入微信 Coding Plan API，并转换流式思考内容与工具调用响应以兼容 DSH。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the WeChat Coding Plan API and adapts streaming reasoning content and tool-call responses for DSH compatibility.

capabilities: Connects to the WeChat Coding Plan OpenAI-compatible API using a configured token
Adapts streaming responses by separating thinking content from final content
Translates tool-call deltas and tool results for DSH compatibility
Supports configurable model reasoning levels, timeouts, retries, and token limits
